audit.why: Chart already reads Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Gwen/Skill/Skill, which matches the mirror audit audits/top/gwen__jayce.json exactly — yours to level 5, hers at 6, even from first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was boilerplate ('Gwen's ultimate changes the math too') and never named the spike.
audit.why: Needlework is 120s at rank 1 with two recasts; Jayce gets no level-6 spike because his R is the stance-swap. The mirror records level 6 as her fight for the same reason.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Needlework and the 120s cost of missing it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The page says the swap TO Hammer shreds her Armor/MR. (b) It says to bait Hallowed Mist and then Thundering Blow her out of the circle from outside.
audit.why: Riot: Mercury Cannon — the hammer-to-cannon swap — is the hit that reduces Armor and MR; the cannon-to-hammer swap deals bonus magic damage instead. And Hallowed Mist means she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist, so a targeted 240-range Thundering Blow cannot reach her unless you step inside it first.
audit.corrected: Shred is on the swap back to Cannon; you must stand in the mist to knock her out of it.

audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash 13s at rank 1 and partially refunded when it hits, so her escape is up far more often than her mist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal line was generic ('his healing fights your pattern'); nothing about her attack-speed on-hit.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off every proc, and Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed, range and magic on-hit, so armour alone misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: Names A Thousand Cuts and the on-hit magic damage.

edits.before: Land the accelerated gate-Q on her step-ups, then Cannon-Q to swap (shred her Armor/MR on the first hit) into Hammer Q-E-W before she can E away
edits.after: Land the accelerated gate-Q on her step-ups, then swap to Hammer for Q-E-W and swap back to Cannon — that first hit is the Armor/MR shred

edits.before: When she pops W Hallowed Mist to go untargetable, use Hammer E (Thundering Blow) to knock her clean out of the mist circle
edits.after: Step into her Hallowed Mist — the only way to target her at all — then Thundering Blow knocks her clean out of the circle

edits.before: Your Cannon-Q then Hammer-swap shred into Q-E-W bursts her before she can E away, and she has no W mist value to blank it yet.
edits.after: Your Cannon-Q into Hammer Q-E-W bursts her before she can E away, and the swap back to Cannon shreds her resists to finish.

edits.before: Gwen has to walk into last-hit range and her W Hallowed Mist gives her nothing yet, so this is a free poke war you win. Open in Cannon form and gate-Q (E into Shock Blast) every time she steps up — the accelerated orb out-ranges anything she has at levels 1-3, and she has no E dash leveled to sidestep it. If she ever commits, Cannon-Q then swap to Hammer (the first hit after the swap shreds her Armor and MR) into Q-E-W to burst her before her short-range kit answers. Don't waste the orb into a wave she's hiding behind; wait for the step-up.
edits.after: Gwen has to walk into last-hit range and her W Hallowed Mist gives her nothing yet, so this is a free poke war you win. Open in Cannon form and gate-Q (E into Shock Blast) every time she steps up — the accelerated orb out-ranges anything she has at levels 1-3, and she has no E dash leveled to sidestep it. If she ever commits, Cannon-Q then swap to Hammer for Q-E-W, then swap back to Cannon — that hit is the one that shreds her Armor and MR. Don't waste the orb into a wave she's hiding behind; wait for the step-up.

edits.before: You're still clearly ahead through 4-5 because she lacks the cooldowns and items to trade back, so keep gate-Q poking and shoving for plates. Level 6 is her window, not yours — your R is just the stance-swap you already had, while her R Needlework lets her recast up to three snip waves for burst and chase, so respect the all-in the moment she hits 6. Your out: when she pops W Hallowed Mist to go untargetable, Hammer E (Thundering Blow) knocks her clean out of the mist circle and ends the cheese. Bait the mist, knock her off it, then disengage with your Hextech Capacitor move-speed swap.
edits.after: You're still clearly ahead through 4-5 because she lacks the cooldowns and items to trade back, so keep gate-Q poking and shoving for plates. Level 6 is her window, not yours — your R is just the stance-swap you already had, while her R Needlework lets her recast up to three snip waves for burst and chase, so respect the all-in the moment she hits 6. Her W Hallowed Mist can only be targeted from inside it: step into the circle, Thundering Blow her out of it, and leave on your Hextech Capacitor move-speed swap before the 18s mist is back.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R is only the stance-swap you already had; her Needlework is a 120s three-recast burst-and-chase window you must survive.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hallowed Mist (W): 22s at rank 1 down to 18s — she is only targetable from inside it. - Skip 'n Slash (E): 13s, partly refunded when it hits. - Needlework: 120s at rank 1, and she can recast it twice more.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer her.
edits.after: Mist only blocks targeting from outside — step in, then Thundering Blow knocks her out of her own circle.

edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse (poke + dive burst), then Serylda's Grudge; boots Mercury's Treads. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — A Thousand Cuts heals off every proc.
